info.title: Khalid API
info.description: The Content API and the Admin API of a Khalid blog. Each key, and each address that sends wrong keys, has a limit a minute; past it the answer is 429 with Retry-After.

get.summary:
Lists who changed what through the Admin API and when, newest first:
every write that succeeded, to content, settings or staff accounts.
Needs `admin:all`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Only changes older than this one, by its `id`: the `next` of the
page before. Left out, the list starts at the newest.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: The limit is not from 1 to 100, or before is not a number

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

get.summary: Lists the newest comments, filtered by status. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only comments with this status, such as `pending` for the queue.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to send, newest first: 50 when not given, at most 100.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: The status or limit is not one the API knows

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

delete.summary: Removes a comment and every reply to it. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

204.description: The comment and its replies are gone

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No comment has this identity

post.summary: Shows a comment under its post. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No comment has this identity

post.summary:
Answers a comment as staff. The reply shows at once, and the comment
it answers is approved. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identity of the comment answered

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No comment has this identity

422.description: The body could not be read, or its name or text cannot be kept

get.summary:
Lists the media library, newest upload first, with the shared list
grammar: `filter`, `order`, `limit` and `page` (RULES.md BL-API-5).
`filter=alt:null+kind:image` finds images still waiting for alt text.
Needs `media:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: A list parameter could not be read

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

post.summary:
Adds the file sent as the body to the media library; its type is read
from its bytes. A file the library already has answers 200 with that
item, so a retry adds no second copy. Needs `media:write`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file's name, made a slug; the extension comes from its content.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The library folder, such as `guides/2026`. The top when left out.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: The library already had this file; the item as it is

400.description: The folder is not up to five slugs joined by /

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

422.description: The file is a type the library refuses, cannot be read, or is too large

get.summary: Reads one item of the media library. Needs `media:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No item has this identity

put.summary:
Changes an item's alt text, caption, focal point or folder; a field left
out stays. The edit carries the `updated_at` of the copy it was made on,
and is a 409 when the item changed since (RULES.md BL-API-7). Needs
`media:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No item has this identity

409.description: The item changed after the copy the edit was made on

422.description: The body could not be read

get.summary:
Lists the addresses that answered 404, most requested first, each with
the nearest page. Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: The limit is not from 1 to 1,000

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

post.summary:
"Redirect this": stores a permanent move from an address that answered
404 to the page given, or to the nearest page, and drops the address
from the log. Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

409.description: The address already has a redirect

422.description: The address or page is not a clean path, or no page is near

get.summary:
Lists posts in every status as rows of the admin's posts table, with
the shared query grammar (RULES.md BL-API-5); any field but `lint` may
be filtered and ordered by. A page holds at most 100 rows, because
each row's findings are counted. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: One page of posts in every status

400.description: A list parameter could not be read, names a field rows do not have, is not one the list takes, or is limit=all

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

post.summary:
Creates a draft post from markdown, or from HTML with `source=html`. A
retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the post the first
request made, so it never makes two (RULES.md BL-API-7). Needs
`posts:write`.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `html` to send the body as HTML; markdown otherwise.

schema.description: What a new post's body is written in.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any text up to 255 characters that names this request, so a retry makes no second post

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: The source is neither markdown nor html

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

422.description: The body could not be read

get.summary: Reads one post in any status. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No post has this identity

put.summary:
Edits one post, and publishes it with `"status": "published"` once
the linter lets it through, or with `"status": "scheduled"` and a
future `published_at` at that time. The edit carries the `updated_at` of the copy it was
made on; when the post changed since, the answer is a 409 naming who
changed it and when (RULES.md BL-API-7). Needs `posts:write`, and
`posts:publish` to publish, schedule or take down a post, or to edit one
that is live or scheduled. A change to head code needs an owner, an
admin or `admin:all`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

403.description: The key lacks posts:write, or posts:publish for an edit that publishes, schedules, takes down or changes a live post, or changes head code without being an owner or admin

404.description: No post has this identity

409.description: The post changed after the copy the edit was made on, or another post has the new slug

422.description: The body could not be read, a setting is not valid, the schedule cannot be kept, or the linter refused to publish the post

delete.summary:
Deletes one post in any status, with its file and its schedule. The
delete names the `updated_at` of the copy it was made on; when the post
changed since, the answer is a 409 naming who changed it and when
(RULES.md BL-API-7). Needs `posts:write`, and `posts:publish` for a
post that is live or scheduled.

parameters.name: updated_at
parameters.description: The post's `updated_at` as last read, such as `2026-10-20T08:30:00Z`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: updated_at is missing or is not a time

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

403.description: The key lacks posts:write, or posts:publish for a live or scheduled post

404.description: No post has this identity

409.description: The post changed after the copy the delete was made on

get.summary:
Checks one post as it would go live now, saving nothing: every lint
finding with the score out of 100, the search result its page would
make, and the JSON-LD the page would carry. A draft is checked as if
published today. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No post has this identity, or this server checks no posts

post.summary:
Makes a link that shows the post, draft or not, in the site's design
to anyone who has it, until it expires: 7 days unless `site.toml` says
otherwise. The page behind it tells search engines not to list it.
Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

201.description: The new link and when it expires

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No post has this identity

422.description: This site makes no preview links

get.summary:
Lists every stored redirect, oldest first. Aliases in front matter are
not listed; they live in their posts. Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

post.summary:
Stores one redirect made by hand. It is checked against every stored
redirect, so it can neither take an address that has one nor close a
loop. Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

409.description: The address already has a redirect

422.description: The redirect cannot be followed or would close a loop

get.summary:
Explains which stored redirect an address matches, every hop of its
chain, and the one step a visitor gets. Aliases in front matter and
pages answer before stored redirects, so they are not shown here.
Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path, from the site root, such as `/blog/old-links/`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: Why the address answers what it does

400.description: The path is not a clean path from the site root

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

get.summary:
Every stored redirect as a CSV list, oldest first, to
open in a spreadsheet or import elsewhere. Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

post.summary:
Stores every redirect in a CSV list, or none. The list is checked row
by row, then together with every stored redirect, so it can neither
take a used address nor close a loop. Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

requestBody.description: A header from,to,status,match (match may be left out), then one redirect a row

201.description: Every redirect in the list, stored

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

409.description: An address in the list already has a redirect

422.description: A row cannot be read or followed, or the list would close a loop

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No redirect has this identity

get.summary:
Lists the site's schema templates, the collections a template may name,
and whether the running server needs a restart to use the templates.
Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: This server keeps no schema templates

put.summary:
Puts a new list in place of every schema template, made on the copy
`updated_at` names. Each template is checked as `khalid serve` checks
`site.toml` at start, and nothing is saved when one is refused. The
running server uses the new templates after a restart. Needs
`settings:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: This server keeps no schema templates

409.description: The templates changed after the copy this change was made on

422.description: The body could not be read, or a template is not valid

get.summary:
Who the session cookie signs in, with its CSRF token again, for an
admin page that was reloaded. Needs the session cookie.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

post.summary:
Signs in with an email and password. The answer sets the session
cookie and holds the CSRF token. Needs no key.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: Signed in; the cookie is set

401.description: The email and password do not match an account

422.description: The body could not be read

429.description: Too many failed sign-ins; Retry-After says when to try again

delete.summary: Signs out: ends this session and clears the cookie.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

204.description: Signed out; the cookie is cleared

post.summary:
Mails a sign-in link to an email that has an account. The answer is
the same whether it has one or not. Needs no key.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

202.description: If the email has an account, a link is on its way

404.description: This site cannot send sign-in links

422.description: The body could not be read

429.description: Too many links asked for; Retry-After says when to try again

post.summary:
Signs in with the token from a sign-in link. The answer sets the
session cookie, like signing in with a password. Needs no key.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: Signed in; the cookie is set

401.description: The link was used, has expired or is unknown

404.description: This site cannot send sign-in links

post.summary:
Signs in with a passkey. The answer sets the session cookie. Needs no
key.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: Signed in; the cookie is set

post.summary: Starts a passkey sign-in. Needs no key.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

404.description: This site has no passkeys

post.summary:
Adds the passkey the browser made to the signed-in account. Needs the
session cookie.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No live session, or the request was used or too old

422.description: The passkey's answer was refused; detail says why

post.summary:
Starts adding a passkey to the signed-in account. Needs the session
cookie.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

404.description: This site has no passkeys

put.summary:
Changes the password of the signed-in account and ends its other
sessions. An account with no password may set its first one only in
the 15 minutes after signing in.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No live session, or the current password is wrong

422.description: The new password is too short or too long

delete.summary:
Signs out everywhere: ends every session of this account, this one
too, for a lost laptop or a stolen cookie.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: Every session ended; the cookie is cleared

get.summary: Lists every staff account. Needs a role that manages staff.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

403.description: This role does not manage staff

post.summary:
Invites a person with a role the caller may manage. They have no
password until they choose one.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

403.description: This role cannot give that role

409.description: An account already has this email

422.description: The body could not be read

put.summary:
Gives an account another role. The caller must manage both its old
role and the new one.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: The account with its new role

403.description: This role cannot make that change

404.description: No account has this number

422.description: The body could not be read

delete.summary:
Removes an account, with its sessions and passkeys. The caller must
manage its role.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

403.description: This role cannot remove that account

404.description: No account has this number

post.summary:
Hands the site to another account: it becomes the owner and the owner
until now becomes an admin. Only the owner, signed in with the session
cookie, may do this; no key can.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account that becomes the owner

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

403.description: Only the signed-in owner may hand the site over

404.description: No other account has this number

AdminChange.description: One change, as the Admin API shows it.

by.description: The identity of the key or staff account that made it.

id.description: Its place in the log: a later change has a larger number.

path.description: The address it was made at.

AdminChanges.description: One page of the audit log.

next.description: The `before` that lists the next page, or null on the last page.

AdminChecks.description: Checks as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminComment.description:
A comment in Admin API shape.

Exhaustive on purpose: the comments crate fills it in.

author_email.description:
The reader's email, when they gave one. Never shown on the site,
and never sent in a webhook.

parent.description: The comment it answers. Threads are one level deep.

post.description: The post it is on, by the post's file in the site folder.

text.description: What it says, as plain text with a line break between lines.

AdminComments.description: Comments as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminMedia.description: A file in the media library with the details kept beside it.

alt.description: What an image shows, for readers who cannot see it.

bytes.description: The size in bytes as stored.

focal_point.description: The part of an image every crop keeps.

folder.description: The library folder, or empty for the top.

height.description: The height in pixels, for images.

id.description: A hash of the uploaded bytes, the same for the same file.

name.description: The file name it is served under.

updated_at.description: When its details last changed. An edit sends this back.

width.description: The width in pixels, for images.

example.name: choosing-a-crm.jpg
example.alt: A sales team comparing two CRM dashboards on one screen

AdminMiss.description: An address that answered 404, as the Admin API shows it.

nearest.description:
The page "redirect this" would send it to, or null when no page is
near enough to guess.

AdminMisses.description: The 404 log as the Admin API wraps it.

AdminPost.description:
A post in Admin API shape: any status, with its markdown source and
the `updated_at` an edit must send back (RULES.md BL-API-7).

author.description: The author's slug, matching a file in the site's `authors/` folder.

markdown.description: The markdown source, which the content file holds.

published_at.description: When it went or goes live; empty for a draft.

settings.description:
The settings beside the title and body, as the admin's settings
panel shows them.

slug.description: The last part of its address.

unpublish_at.description: When it comes down again, if it is scheduled to.

updated.description:
The day of the last real update readers see, which only an edit
with `real_update` moves. Empty until the first one.

updated_at.description: When it last changed. An edit sends this back unchanged.

updated_by.description: Who made the last change: a staff name or a key's identity.

updated_note.description: What changed in the last real update, shown beside its date.

AdminPosts.description: Posts as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminRedirect.description: A stored redirect as the Admin API shows it.

from.description: The path it starts from, or a regular expression over the path.

id.description: The identity to remove it by.

to.description:
Where a move leads: a path, a web address, or a pattern's template
with `$1` for its first group. Empty for 410 and 451.

AdminRedirects.description: Redirects as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminSchemaTemplate.description: One schema template as the Admin API sends and takes it.

applies_to.description: Whether `name` is a collection or a category.

name.description: The collection or category whose posts get the node.

properties.description:
Each property's value, by property name. A value may use the title
template variables, such as `{title}` and `{site}`.

AdminWebhook.description: A webhook as the Admin API lists it. Its secret is never listed.

event.description: The event it sends, from the catalogue in `docs/standards/api.md`.

id.description: The identity to remove it by.

secret.description:
The secret every delivery is signed with. Only the answer that adds
the webhook carries it, once.

AdminWebhooks.description: Webhooks as the Admin API wraps them.

Alias.description:
An old address on this site that redirects to the post, such as
`/2019/05/old-title/`, so a moved post keeps its links.

Author.description: An author in one language, in API shape.

bio.description: The introduction from the author's file, in markdown.

id.description: The language and the slug, such as `en.asif`.

role.description: What the author does, such as `Founder of SerpDad`.

same_as.description: The author's profiles elsewhere, in the order the file gives them.

slug.description: The slug posts name the author by.

url.description: The author's page on the blog, when it has one.

authors.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

Bodies.description: A post's body in each format. A format left out of `formats` is absent.

case_studies.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

categories.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

changelog.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

collections.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

CommentReplies.description: A reply, wrapped the way the Admin API wraps comments: exactly one.

CommentReply.description: A staff reply to a comment.

author_name.description: The name shown with the reply, such as the writer's own.

text.description: What the reply says, as plain text.
text.example: Thanks, Lena. The follow-up post is out next week.

CommentStatus.description: Where a comment stands in moderation.

ContentCollection.description:
A collection in one language, in API shape: the folder's name and the
title and description its `_index.md` gives, when it has one.

description.description: The summary of its list page.

id.description: The language and the folder, such as `en.posts`.

slug.description: The folder's name, such as `posts` or `case-studies`.

title.description: The heading of its list page.

CreateOptions.description:
What the admin passes to `navigator.credentials.create`, as
`{"publicKey": {...}}`.

CustomJsonLd.description:
JSON-LD written by hand for a type Khalid does not write itself, kept
as written. It is read as schema.org nodes before it is kept, so a page
never carries JSON-LD a search engine would throw away.

EditPosts.description: An edit, wrapped the way the Admin API wraps posts: exactly one.

Ended.description: How many sessions signing out everywhere ended.

ExplainedHop.description: One hop of a chain in the debug view.

from.description: The address this hop starts from.

redirect.description: The identity of the stored redirect that answered it.

status.description: What that redirect answers on its own.

to.description: Where it leads, for a move.

FeatureImage.description:
The image at the top of a post and on its cards. The alt text is
required, as for every image (plan section 4.6).

alt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it.

oneOf.description: The line shown under the image, if any.

src.description: A media path such as `/media/anchor-text.jpg`, or a full address.

FocalPointBody.description:
A point in an image in thousandths of its width and height, from the top
left. `{ "x": 500, "y": 500 }` is the centre.

x.description: Thousandths of the width from the left, 0 to 1000.

y.description: Thousandths of the height from the top, 0 to 1000.

Gate.description: The lint publish gate's answer for a post as it stands.

allOf.description: The options, in `publicKey`, and how the browser should ask.

GetOptions.description:
What the admin passes to `navigator.credentials.get`, as
`{"publicKey": {...}, "mediation": "conditional"}`.

glossary.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

IndexStatus.description:
Whether search engines may list a post, as far as the site itself
says. Google's own answer comes with the Search Console connection
(plan section 5.11).

Invite.description:
A person to invite: they sign in by a link sent to their email, then
choose a password or add a passkey.

LinkRedeem.description:
The token from a sign-in link, which the admin's sign-in page reads
after the `#` and posts here.

LinkRequest.description: The email to send a sign-in link to.

email.description: The address the account signs in with.

LintCounts.description:
How many lint findings a post has, by severity. A post with any
`blocks` cannot be published.

blocks.description: Findings that stop the post from going live.

warnings.description: Findings the writer should see, which do not stop it.

MediaEditBody.description: A change to an item's details. A field left out stays as it is.

alt.description: New alt text, up to 1000 characters; empty clears it.

caption.description: A new caption, up to 2000 characters; empty clears it.

folder.description: A new folder, such as `guides/2026`, or empty for the top.

updated_at.description: The `updated_at` of the copy the edit was made on.

MediaEdits.description: An edit, wrapped the way the Admin API wraps resources: exactly one.

MediaItems.description: Media items, wrapped the way the Admin API wraps resources.

MediaList.description: A page of the media library with its pagination.

meta.description: Where this page sits in the list.

Menu.description:
One menu in one language, in API shape, such as the header menu
`primary` or the `footer` menu. An empty menu shows nothing.

id.description: The language and the menu, such as `en.primary`.

links.description: The links, in the order readers see them.

url.description:
Where it goes: a path on the site, such as `/blog/about/`, or a full
address.

navigation.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

NewPasskey.description: A new passkey, as `navigator.credentials.create` returned it.

challenge.description: The `challenge` of the options it answers, as they gave it.

name.description: A name to tell it apart, such as "Work laptop".

NewPost.description: A new post as a client sends it, before any checks.

author.description:
The author's slug, such as `asif`. The linter refuses to publish a
post without one.

slug.description: The slug; made from the title when left out.

NewPosts.description: A new post, wrapped the way the Admin API wraps posts: exactly one.

NewRedirect.description: One new redirect, in the columns [`AdminRedirect`] shows.

from.description: The path it starts from, or a regular expression over the path.

to.description: Where a move leads. Leave it out for 410 and 451.

NewRedirects.description: The body of a new redirect: exactly one.

event.description: The event to send, such as `post.published`.

url.description: Where to send it: an `http` or `https` address.

NewWebhooks.description: The body of a new webhook: exactly one.

NonBlank.description: Text with something in it other than spaces.

pages.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

Pagination.description: Where a page sits in its list, in Ghost's shape.

next.description: The next page, if there is one.

pages.description: How many pages the list has, at least 1.

prev.description: The previous page, if there is one.

total.description: How many items the list has.

challenge.description: The `challenge` of the options it answers, as they gave it.

PasswordChange.description: A new password, with the current one when the account has one.

current.description: The password now; leave it out only to set a first password.

new.description: The new password: at least 12 characters.

allOf.description: The body, in the formats asked for.

authors.description: Author slugs, in the order the writer gave them.

excerpt.description: A short summary, if the writer gave one.

featured.description: Whether the post is marked as featured.

id.description: Stable across edits: the content file's identity.

slug.description: The last part of its address.

tags.description: Tag slugs, in the order the writer gave them.

Post.description:
A published post in API shape. Bodies are present only when asked for
with `formats`.

PostCheck.description: One post's check: findings and score, snippet and schema.

lint.description:
Every finding, as `khalid lint --json` prints them for one post,
with `blocks` and the post's `score` out of 100 and the rules that
cost it points.

schema.description: The JSON-LD the page would carry: `@context` and `@graph`.

snippet.description: The search result the page would make.

PostEdit.description:
An edit to a post: the fields to change, and the `updated_at` of the
copy it was made on. Fields left out keep their value, and `null`
clears one that may be empty. A `status` of `published` publishes a
draft, once the linter lets it through; `scheduled` with a future
`published_at` publishes it then, and `draft` takes a scheduled post
off its schedule and a live post down.

author.description: A new author's slug, or `null` for none.

published_at.description:
When a `scheduled` post goes live: a time to come, with its offset,
such as `2026-11-03T09:00:00+01:00`.

oneOf.description:
Marks the edit as a real update to a live post's text, with a note
saying what changed: the post's `updated` date becomes today. Left
out, the date stays as it is, whatever else changes.
New values for some settings; the rest keep theirs.

slug.description: A new slug. No other post may have it.

status.description:
`published` to publish the post now, `scheduled` to publish it at
`published_at`, or `draft` to cancel a schedule and take a live post
down. Publishing runs
the linter, and a post with a blocking finding stays a draft.

unpublish_at.description:
When the post comes down again: a time to come, after
`published_at` for a scheduled post.

updated_at.description: The `updated_at` of the copy the edit was made on.

PostRow.description: One row of the admin's posts table.

gate.description:
Whether the lint publish gate lets it go live. A list filters by
this, such as `gate:refuses`.

index_status.description: Whether search engines may list it.

lint.description:
Its lint findings, counted. Counting takes every rule, so a list
counts only the rows on the page it sends, and cannot filter or
order by the counts.

published_at.description: When it went or goes live; empty for a draft.

review_due.description:
Whether the post is due for review: more than six months since it
was last reviewed or published, whichever came last. A list
filters by this, such as `filter=review:due`.

reviewed.description: The day it last came up for review (F3), if it ever has.

slug.description: The last part of its address.

PostRows.description: One page of the admin's posts table, as every list is wrapped.

PostSettings.description:
A post's settings beside its title and body. Every setting has a
value: empty lists, `false`, `draft` and `null` when never set.

access.description: Who may read the body: `public`, or `members`, who are signed in.

canonical.description: The address search engines should credit instead of this post.

co_authors.description: The other authors' slugs, after the author.

date.description: The day the post is dated, as shown to readers.

oneOf.description: The summary for cards, feeds and search results.
The image at the top of the post.

featured.description: Whether the post is featured in lists and the featured channel.

focus_keyword.description:
The one search phrase the post is written to answer, which the
linter checks the title, description and text against.

head_code.description:
Checked HTML added to the post's page head, such as an analytics
tag. Only owners and admins may change it.

password_protected.description:
Whether a reader must give a password to read the body. The
password itself is never sent back.

review_state.description: Where the post stands in review.

reviewed.description:
The day the post last came up for review and was looked at (F3).
A review that changes nothing sets this alone; it never moves
`date`, and a real change is what sets `updated` in the front
matter.

robots.description: The post's own robots directives, in place of the site's.

oneOf.description:
Hand-written JSON-LD the page carries beside the schema Khalid
writes, for a type Khalid does not write itself.

The title search results show, in place of the site's title
template, or `null` for the template's.

share_cards.description: How the post looks when shared on X and Facebook.

template.description:
The theme template the post is shown with, such as `wide` for
`theme/templates/post-wide.html`, or `null` for `post.html`.

posts.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

PreviewLink.description: A link to a draft, and when it stops working.

url.description:
The address to share, such as
`https://www.example.com/blog/preview/en.choosing-anchor-text/?until=1793696400&sig=...`.

PreviewLinks.description: Preview links, wrapped the way the Admin API wraps resources.

Problem.description:
An error as the API sends it (RULES.md BL-ERR-5): `type`, `title`,
`status` and `detail`, plus `fix`, and `rule` and `instance` where they
apply. `detail` and `fix` come from a [`UserMessage`], so they say what
happened, why it matters and what to do (BL-ERR-4).

detail.description: What happened and why it matters.

instance.description: The address the problem is about.

lint.description:
For a post the linter refused, every finding, as `khalid lint
--json` prints them for one post, and the post's `score` out of 100
with the rules that cost it points.

rule.description: The lint rule or parameter that produced the problem.

title.description: The same short title for every problem of this kind.

type.description: A link to the page that explains this kind of problem.

RealUpdate.description:
An edit's claim that it is a real update: it changes what a live post
says, and `note` tells readers what. Only then does the post's
updated date become today. Title, description and settings edits
alone never move it.

note.description:
What changed, in one short sentence, such as "Refreshed the 2024
numbers." Shown beside the updated date. At most 160 characters.

RedirectExplanation.description: Why an address answers what it answers: the debug view.

hops.description: Each hop from the address to the end of its chain.

matched.description: The identity of the stored redirect it matched, if any.

status.description: The one status a visitor gets, if a redirect matched.

to.description: Where a visitor is sent in one step, for a move.

RedirectMiss.description: The address to redirect, and where to.

to.description: The page to send it to. Leave it out for the nearest page.

ReviewState.description: Where a post stands in review, before it is published (KH-EDT-4).

RoleChange.description: A new role for an account.

SchemaTemplates.description: The site's schema templates, in the order `site.toml` lists them.

collections.description: The site's collections, to pick a template's collection from.

restart_needed.description:
Whether the running server still uses older templates, so a restart
is needed before previews and served pages show these.

templates.description: Every template. When two of one type cover a post, the first wins.

updated_at.description: When `site.toml` last changed. A change sends it back.

SearchTitle.description:
The title search results show for a post, in place of the site's title
template. It may use the template variables, such as `{site}`.
SearchTitle.example: Anchor text that says where it goes {sep} {site}

SessionAnswer.description:
A signed-in session: who it is, and the CSRF token every request with
the cookie sends in `x-khalid-csrf`.

Settings.description:
The public settings of the site, in API shape: its name, where it lives
and its languages. Nothing secret is ever part of it.

default_language.description: The language a reader gets first, such as `en`.

languages.description: Every language the site is written in, the default among them.

url.description: The address of the blog's front page in the default language.

SettingsEdit.description:
New values for some of a post's settings. A setting left out keeps
its value, and `null` clears one that may be empty.

access.description: Who may read the body: `public`, or `members`, who are signed in.

aliases.description: Every old address that redirects here.

canonical.description: A new canonical address, or `null` for the post's own.

co_authors.description: The other authors' slugs, all of them.

date.description: A new date, as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null` for none.

excerpt.description: A new excerpt, or `null` for none.

oneOf.description: A new feature image, or `null` for none.

focus_keyword.description: A new focus keyword, or `null` for none.

head_code.description: New head code, or `null` for none. Owners and admins only.

password.description:
A new password of 8 to 128 characters that readers must give, or
`null` to remove it. It is kept only as a hash.

reviewed.description:
The day the post was last looked over (F3), or `null` for never.
Setting it records a review and nothing else: it never moves the
post's date or its updated date.

robots.description: New robots directives, or `null` for the site's.

schema.description: New hand-written JSON-LD, or `null` for none.

seo_title.description: A new search title, or `null` for the site's title template.
seo_title.example: Anchor text that says where it goes {sep} {site}

oneOf.description:
Both share cards; a card left out uses the post's own title,
excerpt and image.

template.description: A theme template such as `wide`, or `null` for `post.html`.

ShareCard.description:
How a post looks when shared on one network. Anything left out comes
from the post's title, excerpt and feature image.

oneOf.description: A media path or address, in place of the feature image.

ShareCards.description: The share cards for X and Facebook (plan section 4.6).

oneOf.description: The card on Facebook, and on other sites that read Open Graph.

SignInBody.description: An email and password to sign in with.

email.description: The address the account signs in with.

SiteSettings.description: The site's settings, as every response wraps them: a list of one.

Snippet.description:
The lines of a search result: the title, the address and the
description, as the page's head gives them.

description.description: The meta description, or empty when the page has none.
description.example: Pick words that say where the link goes.

title.description: The `<title>`, after the site's title template.
title.example: Choosing anchor text | Field Notes on SEO

StaffAccount.description: A staff account as the Admin API shows it.

email.description: The address they sign in with.

id.description: The account's number on this site.

StaffList.description: Staff accounts, as the Admin API wraps them.

tags.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

TemplatesChange.description: A new list of schema templates, made on the copy `updated_at` names.

templates.description: Every template, in order. An empty list removes them all.

updated_at.description: The `updated_at` of the copy the change was made on.

Term.description:
A tag or a category in one language, in API shape. Both are a name for
a group of posts, so they share one shape.

id.description: The language and the slug, such as `en.on-page-seo`.

name.description: The name readers see in this language.

slug.description: The slug posts name it by.

TrashList.description: The trash as the Admin API wraps it.

trash.description: The deleted posts, the most recently deleted first.

TrashedPost.description: A deleted post, as the Admin API shows it.

id.description: The post's identity when it was deleted.

key.description: Names this copy in the trash, for restoring or deleting it.

status.description: Its status when it was deleted.

admin_key.name: Authorization
admin_key.description: An integration key or staff token, as Khalid followed by the key.

content_key.name: Authorization
content_key.description: The site's content key, as Khalid-Content followed by the key.

staff_session.name: __Host-khalid-session
staff_session.description: A signed-in staff session. Every request with it also sends the session's CSRF token in the x-khalid-csrf header.
